documentation.content: Cloud Functions are returning server errors. Check Error Reporting and the function logs.

conditions.displayName: More than 10 server errors in 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx" AND resource.labels.service_name != "gotenberg"
